blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Biological visual systems compute reliably under tight metabolic and wiring constraints, whereas artificial vision systems consume far more energy and can be sensitive to adversarial perturbations. Whether networks with brain-like wiring are more robust at lower computational cost is unclear. We address this by benchmarking a task-optimized, continuous-time recurrent neural network of the fly visual system constrained by its synaptic connectome (FlyNet) against artificial neural networks. We compare it against CNNs, RAFT, and continuous-time recurrent neural networks without detailed connectome constraints (sCTRNN, CTRNN) on a collision-detection task within a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline. FlyNet is adversarially vulnerable but, relative to its compute, more robust to common video corruptions than RAFT, while using up to five orders of magnitude fewer FLOPs. The CTRNNs remain more robust than FlyNet across almost all tested perturbations, suggesting that connectome constraints benefit efficiency, through their low edge count, over robustness. Recurrence improves robustness to white-box attacks in RAFT and temporal context improves robustness to common corruptions. FlyNet's position and velocity representations degrade under adversarial textures but recover under counterfactual textures that restore correct classification while staying equally far from training, ruling out unfamiliar textures as the cause of failure. The reverse-phi illusion similarly disrupts these representations and inverts the same low-level motion statistic as the adversarial textures. Optimizing this input statistic alone, without access to the network, suffices to induce classification failure, attributing both perturbations to the same circuit vulnerability. Connectome-constrained models can thus surface adversarial failure mechanisms as testable hypotheses about biological perceptual vulnerabilities.
blocks.zh: 生物视觉系统在严格的代谢和接线限制下可靠地计算出,而人工视觉系统消耗的能量要多得多并可能对对抗性扰动敏感. 具有类似大脑接线的网络是否以较低的计算成本更坚固,这一点尚不清楚. 我们通过将一个任务优化的、连续的反复出现的飞行视觉系统神经网络作为基准来解决这个问题,这个神经网络受到其突触连接体(FlyNet)与人工神经网络的制约。 我们把它和CNN,RAFT, 以及没有详细连接体限制(sCTRNN,CTRNN)的连续时间反复神经网络相比, FlyNet在对抗性上是脆弱的,但相对于其计算而言,相对于RAFT来说,它比普通的视频腐败更为强大,而FLOP的使用量则会减少多达五个数量级. 几乎所有经过测试的扰动中,CTRNN仍然比FlyNet更强大,这表明连接体的制约通过其低边数比稳健性提高了效率。 在RAFT中,再现会提高白箱攻击的强度,而时间背景则会提高常见腐败的强度。 FlyNet的地位和速度表示在对立纹理下会退化,但在反事实纹理下恢复,恢复正确的分类,同时同样远离训练,排除了不熟悉的纹理作为失败原因. 反相幻象同样地干扰了这些表达,并颠倒了与对抗纹理相同的低等运动统计. 仅优化这种输入统计,而不进入网络,就足以诱发分类失败,使扰动都归咎于同样的电路脆弱性。 因此,Connectedome-contracted models可以将表面对抗性故障机制作为生物认知弱点的可测试假设.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Biological neural systems compute reliably despite stochastic components and variable inputs [ 1 ] , and do so under tight metabolic and wiring constraints [ 2 , 3 ] . But these systems are not perturbation-proof: Classical visual illusions expose the limits of computational mechanisms of biological perception [ 4 ] . Artificial neural networks, by contrast, consume vastly more energy [ 5 ] and can fail under various perturbations [ 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 ] .
Do artificial and biological neural networks specialized for the same task share the same failure modes? Linking both has been hard because the systems one can attack with gradients are not biologically wired. To our knowledge, no perceptual illusion has yet been tied to an adversarial stimulus in the same system at the level of a computation both exploit.
blocks.zh:
生物神经系统尽管有分泌成分和可变输入[1],但计算可靠,在严格的代谢和接线限制下进行[2,3]. 但这些系统并不防扰:古典视觉幻觉暴露出生物感知的计算机制的极限[4]. 相形之下,人工神经网络消耗的能量大大增加[5],在各种扰动下可以失效[6,7,8,9].
专门从事同一任务的人工神经网络和生物神经网络是否共享同样的故障模式? 两者的连接一直很困难,因为可以用梯度攻击的系统没有生物线. 据我们所知,还没有一种观念上的幻觉与同一系统中的敌对刺激联系在一起,这种刺激在计算这两种利用的水平上都是如此。

blocks.en: Robustness — the ability to maintain reliable computation under perturbations — of a biological neural network can now directly be evaluated with FlyNet [ 10 ] , a fly visual system model constrained by real synaptic wiring. It was trained on motion detection, an ecologically essential task for the fly, using the Sintel optical flow dataset [ 11 ] and recapitulates single-neuron response properties across three decades of experimental research, without training on that data. In artificial networks, robustness is linked to specific architectural features — recurrence [ 12 , 13 , 14 ] , global processing [ 15 , 16 ] , and continuous-time dynamics [ 17 , 18 ] . FlyNet has little of these: it uses continuous-time dynamics but has sparse recurrence and primarily local connectivity, reflecting the predominantly feedforward organization of the fly optic lobe. Any robustness it exhibits might therefore arise from properties other than recurrence or global integration, possibly shaped through evolution under tight metabolic constraints [ 2 , 3 ] . Does biological wiring contribute to robustness, to efficiency, or to both?
blocks.zh: 强力——在扰动下维持可靠计算的能力——生物神经网络现在可以直接被FlyNet[10]评价,这个飞行视觉系统模型受到真实突触接线的限制. 它接受了运动探测培训,这是苍蝇在生态上必不可少的一项任务,它利用了Sintel光学流数据集[11],并在30年的实验研究中重新概括了单中子反应特性,而没有对这些数据进行培训. 在人造网络中,稳健性与具体的建筑特征——重现[12,13,14],全球加工[15,16],以及持续时间动态[17,18]相接. FlyNet几乎没有这些功能:它使用连续的时空动态,但重复性很少,而且主要是局部连接,反映了苍蝇光学叶片主要向后排列。 因此,它显示的任何强性可能来自重现性或全球融合以外的特性,这些特性可能在严格的代谢制约下通过演化而形成[2,3]. 生物接线是有助于稳健性、效率还是两者兼而有之?

blocks.en: We designed a behaviorally grounded, looming-based collision-detection task to evaluate robustness in both connectome-constrained networks and conventional optic-flow models. We implemented the task in a fully differentiable 3D rendering pipeline, in which textured objects follow parametric trajectories toward the observer. Rather than optimizing perturbations in pixel-space — where they lose effectiveness under geometric transformations [ 19 , 20 ] — we optimize textures directly in 3D scene space, ensuring physical consistency across frames as objects scale during looming. We evaluate models under both adversarial attacks and common video perturbations (e.g., flicker, fog), and pair each robustness measurement with computational cost in FLOPs per inference to characterize robustness relative to efficiency.
blocks.zh: 我们设计了一个基于行为、以接近为基础的碰撞探测任务,以评估连接体受限网络和常规光学流模型中的稳健性。 我们在一条完全不同的三维渲染管中执行这项任务,其中有纹理的物体沿着参数轨迹向观察者走. 与其优化像素-空间的扰动——在几何变换[19,20]下失去有效性——不如直接在3D场景空间中优化纹理,确保相框之间的物理相容性在临近时作为物体尺度. 我们评价对抗性攻击和常见视频扰动(如闪光器、雾)下的模型,并将每个稳健度测量值与FLOPs的计算成本进行配对,以说明稳健度相对于效率的特征。

blocks.en: The main contributions of our work are: • A differentiable 3D rendering pipeline for a binary collision detection task (approaching objects that hit or miss the observer) in which adversarial attacks optimize object textures for differentiable motion-perception models. • A direct comparison of gradient-based adversarial attacks and the reverse-phi illusion on the same connectome-constrained, task-optimized model of the fly visual system (FlyNet). • Using counterfactual restoration , we find textures equally far from the training distribution that recover classification accuracy and position and velocity readouts, linking failure to motion-code disruption, not unfamiliar textures. • We identify the computation both perturbations exploit: Adversarial textures and reverse-phi both invert the Hassenstein–Reichardt correlation between radially neighboring inputs, and optimizing this statistic alone is sufficient to induce or reverse classification failure. • We benchmark robustness–efficiency trade-offs across architectures with different inductive biases (recurrence, global signals, continuous-time dynamics) under adversarial attacks and common video perturbations. • We find that FlyNet and sCTRNN have higher robustness per order of magnitude of compute than every other architecture on common video corruptions of the collision-detection task.
blocks.zh: 我们工作的主要贡献是: • 用于二进制相撞探测任务的可分化的3D渲染管道(接近撞击或错过观察者的物体),其中对抗式攻击优化了不同运动感知模型的物体纹理. 二. 支助 以梯度为主的对抗性攻击和同一种接合自控,任务优化的飞行视觉系统模型(FlyNet)上反相幻相的直接比较. • 利用反事实修复,我们发现纹理与培训分布相去甚远,这些纹理可以恢复分类的准确性、位置和读取速度,将失败与运动码中断联系起来,而不是不熟悉的纹理。 我们确定计算时既包括扰动利用: 反向纹理和反向-phi两种反向倒置 Hassenstein – Reichardt 辐射相邻输入之间的关联性,仅优化这一统计就足以诱发或反向分类失败 。 我们把稳健性——在对抗攻击和常见的视频扰动下,在具有不同诱导偏差(再现、全球信号、持续时间动态)的架构之间实现效率取舍——作为基准。 我们发现,FlyNet和SCTRNN在计算数量顺序上,比其他每个架构在常见的相撞-探测任务上都具有更高的强度.

blocks.en: 2 Background
blocks.zh: 2 背景情况

blocks.en:
In the Drosophila optic lobe (Supp. Fig. 1 a), visual motion detection is decomposed into parallel ON and OFF pathways, mediated by the T4 and T5 neurons, respectively [ 21 ] . These neurons act as local moving-edge detectors, with T4 and T5 selective for ON and OFF edges, each with subtypes (a, b, c, d) selective for the four cardinal directions of motion, forming a distributed basis for local motion encoding [ 22 ] . These local directional signals are subsequently integrated by Lobula Plate-Lobula Columnar neurons, such as LPLC2, which are selectively tuned to radial expansion patterns associated with looming, and then project to giant fiber descending neurons driving escape behaviors such as jumping [ 23 , 24 , 25 ] . This hierarchical integration encodes collision-relevant variables —including radial expansion, object position, and velocity— establishing a shared representational substrate from which multiple task-relevant variables can be decoded.
There has been extensive computational work applying structural constraints from the fruit fly on neural networks [ 26 , 27 , 28 , 10 ] . blocks.en: Biological visual systems estimate motion accurately under natural conditions, but illusory stimuli that deviate from natural scene statistics elicit systematic perceptual errors, reflecting adaptations of neural circuitry to natural environments [ 4 ] . A canonical example is the reverse-phi illusion, when the contrast of a moving pattern is inverted between successive frames —bright regions become dark and vice-versa— the perceived direction of motion reverses, in humans [ 29 , 30 , 31 ] , macaques [ 32 ] , and flies [ 33 , 31 ] . Flies, when presented with a reverse-phi stimulus, turn their body in the direction opposite to the physical motion, a reflex that reflects the inversion of direction-selective T4/T5 signals [ 34 , 33 , 35 , 36 ] .

blocks.en: Neural networks are vulnerable to small, targeted perturbations that induce misclassification [ 6 ] . Such perturbations can be designed under worst-case gradient-based attacks (PGD [ 8 ] , CW [ 37 ] ), gradient-free methods (NES [ 38 ] ), and common video perturbations such as noise, flicker, and fog [ 9 , 39 ] . Such adversarial examples often transfer across models, revealing shared vulnerabilities [ 40 ] . In optical flow specifically, patch-based adversarial attacks can severely corrupt motion estimation [ 41 , 42 ] , and global norm-constrained perturbations show that state-of-the-art networks are particularly vulnerable [ 43 ] . However, pixel-space and patch-based perturbations often lose effectiveness under minor geometric transformations [ 19 , 20 ] as they do not capture how perturbations evolve under coherent object motion. Optimizing textures over 3D objects addresses this in still images [ 44 ] . In optical flow, adversarial particles rendered consistently in 3D degrade methods that are robust to per-pixel attacks [ 45 ] , but adversarial textures on moving objects remain unexplored.
blocks.zh: 神经网络容易受到小而有目标的干扰,诱发错误分类[6]. 这种扰动可以在最坏情况梯度攻击(PGD [8], CW [37]),无梯度方法(NES [38]),以及噪音,闪光等常见视频扰动和雾 [9,39] 下设计出. 这种对抗性的例子经常跨模式转移,暴露出共同的脆弱性[40]。 在光学流中,基于补丁的对抗性攻击会严重地破坏运动估计[41,42],全球规范受限的扰动表明,最先进的网络特别脆弱[43]. 然而,像素-空间和以补丁为基础的扰动在微小的几何转换 [19,20] 下往往会失去有效性,因为它们无法捕捉扰动如何在连贯的物体运动下演化. 优化3D对象的纹理在静态图像中处理此问题 [44]. 在光学流中,对抗粒子在3D中连续地被制成可强力到每像素攻击的分解方法[45],但在移动物体上相对抗的纹理仍未被探索.

blocks.en: 3.1 A differentiable 3D rendering pipeline for a looming motion perception task
blocks.zh: 3.1 国家 为即将到来的运动感知任务提供不同的 三维渲染管道

blocks.en: We assess motion perception as a binary decision task in a visual looming paradigm, where an approaching object must be classified as hit or miss [ 46 ] . This task is a canonical, behaviorally grounded paradigm in Drosophila [ 47 , 25 ] . To generate stimuli, we develop a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline implemented in pytorch3d [ 48 ] , which provides full control over scene geometry and ensures that physical perturbations evolve consistently with the underlying dynamics across time (Figure 1 ). We render grayscale sequences at 416 × 416 416\times 416 pixels and 100 100 Hz, and, when required, map them onto a hexagonal visual sampler before feeding them to each model. The resulting model activity is then used by a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) decoder to produce the final decision (Figure 1 a). All stimuli are defined in the reference frame of the fly-observer, modeled as a point-particle camera fixed at the origin. We initialize objects at distance z 0 z_{0} from the origin, with positions parameterized by polar coordinates ( R , θ ) (R,\theta) in the plane orthogonal to the z z -axis, enabling isotropic sampling of trajectories across the visual field (Figure 1 b). Each trajectory consists of a linear translation in 3D space over duration T traj T_{\text{traj}} , directed either toward the origin ( hit ) or toward a nearby offset endpoint ( miss ). This construction yields controlled deviations from collision while preserving comparable motion statistics across conditions. The resulting trajectories span angular sizes from ∼ 5 {\sim}5 – 110 ∘ 110^{\circ} , with peak angular expansion speeds of up to 1,420 ∘ / s 1{,}420^{\circ}/\mathrm{s} , consistent with the looming-escape literature: 5 5 – 90 ∘ 90^{\circ} [ 25 ] and 650 650 – 2,100 ∘ / s 2{,}100^{\circ}/\mathrm{s} [ 47 ] . blocks.en: 3.2 Architectures
blocks.zh: 3.2 建筑

blocks.en:
FlyNet is derived from the connectome-constrained recurrent model of the Drosophila visual system [ 10 ] , with 45,669 45{,}669 neurons and 1.51M anatomically constrained edges, trained on Sintel optical flow [ 11 ] with only 734 free parameters.
We edited the weights of two pretrained model instances to create a hybrid model, exhibiting accurate direction selectivity for all T4 and T5 subtypes (App. A.1.1 , Supp. Fig. 1 ). As a control, we evaluate CTRNN, a FlyNet variant with the same dynamics, input, and cell-type connectivity, but without single-cell connectivity, synapse counts and synapse signs from the connectome, trained under the same Sintel protocol. It has 7.51M edges, connecting cells of the 604 connected cell-type pairs through isotropic convolutional connectivity over a hexagonal kernel of 19 columns (five columns across), yielding 11,593 free parameters [ 10 ] . As an edge-count-matched control, we additionally evaluate a sparsity-matched CTRNN variant (sCTRNN). Starting from the trained CTRNN, we untied the shared filter weights, pruned per-edge by the mean absolute injected current, down to FlyNet’s 1.51M connections, and fine-tuned on Sintel. It recovered optical-flow performance to an EPE 2% below FlyNet’s on held-out Sintel samples.
All models here are evaluated using instantaneous T4/T5 responses (5,768 units) as decoder input (see App. A.1.1 , A.1.2 , and A.1.3 for details). Their dynamics follow Eq. 1 , integrated using Euler with d ​ t = 0.01 dt=0.01 . They receive as input the luminance of the visual stimulus sequence, sampled to a regular hexagonal lattice of 721 columns.
blocks.zh:
FlyNet取自Drosophila视觉系统的连接-受约束的常年模型[10],有45,669个45{,}669个神经元和1,51M个解剖受限的边缘,受过辛特尔光学流[11]的培训,只有734个自由参数.
我们编辑了两个预先训练过的模型实例的权重,以创建混合模型,对所有T4和T5子类型显示准确的方向选择性(App. A.1.1,Supp. Fig. 1 )。 作为一个控制,我们评价CTRNN,一个FlyNet的变体,具有相同的动态,输入,和细胞类型的连通性,但是没有单细胞的连通性,突触计数和来自连接体的突触信号,在同一个Sintel协议下训练. 它有7.51M的边缘,通过同位素相生回旋相接的由19个柱(横跨5个柱)组成的六边形内核连接604个相接细胞型对的细胞,生成了11,593个自由参数 [10]. 作为边缘计数相匹配的控制,我们额外评价了相相匹配的CTRNN变体(sCTRNN). 从训练有素的CTRNN开始,我们解开共享的滤波器重量,被平均绝对注入的电流推倒到FlyNet的1.51M连接,并在Sintel上进行微调. 它在被搁置的Sintel样本中将光学流能恢复到低于FlyNet2%的EPE。
此处所有模型均使用即时T4/T5响应(5,768个单位)作为解码器输入(详见App.A.1.1,A.1.2和A.1.3)进行评价. 它们的动力学跟随Eq. 1,用Eular进行集成,dt=0.01 dt=0.01. 它们作为输入接收了视觉刺激序列的亮度,被取样到由721个柱组成的正六边形花纹上.

blocks.en: We evaluate four feedforward CNN baselines following a FlowNet-inspired architecture [ 49 ] ( ∼ 414 {\sim}414 k parameters), pretrained on Sintel and using the same hexagonal visual sampling as FlyNet. The vanilla CNN (vCNN) processes 2 consecutive frames using local receptive fields, while its global variant (gCNN) incorporates channel-wise global pooling into the second hidden layer (Supp. Fig. 3 ) to probe the role of global integration . We also train two vCNN variants using 5 and 10 input frames, respectively, while keeping the remaining architecture unchanged; to assess the effect of temporal context . For all CNN variants, features are extracted from the final hidden layer (7,688 activations). As a higher-performance baseline, we evaluate RAFT [ 50 ] , pretrained and fine-tuned on Sintel ( ∼ 5.3 ​ M {\sim}5.3\text{M} parameters). We extract pooled features from the final hidden representation (6,802 activations) and vary recurrent iterations (1, 6, 12) to probe the role of recurrence . We also evaluate RAFT-small (RAFTsm, ∼ 1 ​ M {\sim}1\text{M} parameters) as a lower-parameter baseline. These models receive the original 416 × 416 416\times 416 luminance frames replicated across three channels. To control for differences in input representation and training regime, we additionally trained RAFT hex-matched variants exclusively on Sintel using the same hexagonally sampled input as FlyNet and the CNN baselines (hexRAFT; Supp. Fig. 4 ).
blocks.zh: 我们根据FlowNet启发的架构[49](QQ 414 {\ sim}414 k参数), 香草有线电视新闻网(vCNN)利用本地可接收域连续处理2个帧,而其全球变体(gCNN)将频道全球集成到第二个隐藏层(Supp. Fig. 3),以探索全球一体化的作用。 我们还分别使用5个和10个输入框来培训两个vCNN变体,同时保持剩余结构不变;评估时间背景的影响。 对于所有CNN变体,从最终隐藏层取出特征(7,688活化). 作为更高的性能基线,我们评价RAFT[50],在Sintel上经过了预先训练和微调(\\ 5.3 M\sim}5.3\text{M}参数). 我们从最后隐藏的表示(6,802活化)中提取集合特征,并改变反复重复(1,6,12),以探索再现的作用。 我们还评价RAFT- small(RAFTsm, ∼ 1 M {\ sim} 1\text{M}参数)为下参数基线. 这些型号接收了由三个频道所复制的416×416正时的416发光帧. 为了控制输入表示和培训制度的差异,我们利用FlyNet和CNN基线(hexRAFT;Supp. Fig. 4)相同的六边形抽样输入,在Sintel上另外培训了RAFT六相匹配的变体。

blocks.en:
Task-specific MLPs are trained on frozen network representations on ∼ 600,000 {\sim}600{,}000 samples from 6,000 trials, and tested on ∼ 40,000 {\sim}40{,}000 held-out samples from 400 trials. Each trial contributes 50–150 timepoints (100 Hz, durations 0.5–1.5 s), treated as independent samples. We train a binary hit/miss classifier ( 512 512 hidden units, tanh \tanh ) and a continuous position/velocity regressor ( 128 − 16 128-16 hidden units, ReLU) (App. A.7 , Supp. Fig. 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 ). Both trained with Adam [ 51 ] ( lr = 10 − 3 \text{lr}=10^{-3} , batch size 1024 1024 ).
Our decoder architecture is inspired by how the fly visual system is organized for collision-detection: The fly’s LPLC2 neurons detect radial expansion patterns and, by nonlinearly integrating dendritic inputs from T4 and T5 neurons (spatially), trigger the animal’s escape response [ 24 ] . Since this mechanism integrates spatial patterns, we used a nonlinear, spatial-only decoder architecture to abstract LPLC2 computation.

blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: 4.1 Adversarial failures arise from disrupted motion representations
blocks.zh: 4.1 动议陈述的中断造成横向失败

blocks.en: FlyNet maintains hit/miss classification accuracy under common video corruptions – additive white noise, shot noise, flicker, motion jitter, and contrast reduction (Fig. 2 a; Supp. Fig. 23 , 24 ) – but accuracy plummets under optimized adversarial attacks targeting the looming object’s texture (Fig. 2 b; Supp. Fig. 18 , 19 , 21 , 22 ). We asked what the adversarial perturbations are exploiting. Do they disrupt the motion representations that FlyNet was trained to compute, or do they push the input outside the training texture distribution?
blocks.zh: FlyNet维持了常见视频腐败下的命中/误差分类精度 — — 添加出白噪声、射出噪声、闪烁声、运动快感和缩小对比(图2 a; Supp. 图23, 24 ) — — 但在针对即将到来物体的纹理的优化对抗攻击下,精度急剧下降(图2 b; Supp. 图18, 19, 21, 22 )。 我们问,对抗性的骚扰在利用什么。 他们是否干扰FlyNet接受过计算训练的动作表述,还是将输入推到训练纹理分布之外?

blocks.en:
Reverse-phi is a known illusion in real flies that disrupts motion representations. It inverts the contrast between successive frames, evoking illusory reversed motion through inversion of T4/T5 direction-selective signals [ 34 , 33 , 35 ] . Using familiar textures, we constructed reverse-phi looming stimuli by inverting the object’s contrast every T T seconds. Under this stimulus, p ⁡ ( hit ) p(\text{hit}) drops sharply at each contrast inversion and recovers between them (Fig. 2 c), mirroring the optomotor inversion seen in real flies [ 33 ] .
Position and velocity decoded from FlyNet activity show the same dependence: decoding errors spike at each inversion (Fig. 2 d) and depend on T T . Short T T gives the network too little time to recover, long T T returns both p ⁡ ( hit ) p(\text{hit}) and decoding errors toward baseline (Supp. Fig. 9 ). Reverse-phi establishes that motion representations can be disrupted without any input-texture distribution shift.

blocks.en: To test whether adversarial failure arises from the same kind of within-distribution disruption, we optimized a texture to suppress p ⁡ ( hit ) p(\text{hit}) on a hit trajectory (Eq. 2 ), then optimized the nearest texture that recovers correct classification (Eq. 3 ). The restored texture remains as far from the training distribution as the illusion texture throughout optimization (Supp. Fig. 11 ). If unfamiliar textures were the cause of failure, restored textures should disrupt accuracy as strongly, which they don’t. Position and velocity readouts recover alongside p ⁡ ( hit ) p(\text{hit}) (Fig. 3 a,b; Supp. Fig. 12 ) consistent with the adversarial restoration recovering the same motion code that reverse-phi disrupts. Single T4/T5 traces show that the illusion texture shifts activity in the same direction as reverse-phi during the inversion phase, consistent with both perturbations engaging T4/T5 motion detectors in the same direction (Supp. Fig. 14 ). To quantify this effect at the population level, we compared responses across all 5,768 T4/T5 neurons in a 330-ms window aligned to reverse-phi contrast inversions ( n = 30 n=30 trajectories). Activity induced by the adversarial illusion was the closest to reverse-phi’s, compared to both the original and the restored conditions (all metrics p < 0.005 p<0.005 ; Supp. Fig. 15 ; see App. B.4 ), suggesting that adversarial textures and reverse-phi may exploit similar computational vulnerabilities.
blocks.zh: 为了测试对抗性失败是否由同一种分配内干扰而产生,我们优化了一种纹理来压制被击中轨迹上p-Q (命中) p(\text{hit}),然后优化了最近恢复正确分类的纹理 (Eq. 3). 恢复的纹理与训练分布相去甚远,如同整个优化过程的幻觉纹理一样(附录11)。 如果不熟悉的纹理是失败的原因,恢复的纹理应该会强烈地破坏准确性,而它们不会破坏准确性。 位置和速度读取与 p \\ (命中) p(\text{ hit}) (图 3 a,b; Supp. 图 12) 同步恢复, 与对抗性恢复一致 , 恢复反向- phi 干扰的同一种运动代码 。 单T4/T5痕迹显示,幻觉纹理在反相相相相相相向同方向转移活性,这与T4/T5运动探测器在同相相向相向时的扰动一致(Supp. fig. 14. 为了量化这种在人口层面的影响,我们比较了所有5,768个T4/T5神经元在330毫秒窗口中与逆-phis反向反相(n=30n=30轨迹)一致的反应. 与原始条件和恢复条件相比,对抗性假象引起的活动最接近于反向假象(所有度量衡p < 0.005 p < 0.005;Supp. Fig. 15;见App.B.4),这表明对抗性纹理和反向假象可能利用类似的计算弱点。

blocks.en: We hypothesized that both perturbations act on the same second-order motion statistic: The delayed correlation between neighboring inputs that Hassenstein–Reichardt correlators read out [ 53 ] , to which T4/T5 direction selectivity is sensitive [ 34 ] , and which reverse-phi is known to invert [ 33 ] . To test this, at each step of counterfactual restoration, we computed the HR correlator (Eq. 4 ). We found that it closely tracks the motion decoding errors (Fig. 3 c; Supp. Fig. 17 a). Supporting our hypothesis, when the network is maximally fooled, HR reaches values close to the ones from reverse-phi (Fig. 3 c, Supp. Fig. 16 b). To test whether disrupting this statistic is sufficient for failure, we separately minimized and maximized g ⁡ ( τ = 8 ​ frames = 80 ​ ms ) g(\tau=8\,\mathrm{frames}=80\,\mathrm{ms}) (Eq. 4 ), without access to the network. Under minimization p ⁡ ( hit ) p(\text{hit}) drops to ∼ 0.3 \sim 0.3 , whereas under maximization it stays above 0.8 0.8 (Fig. 3 d; Supp. Fig. 17 b, 13 ). Manipulating this statistic alone is thus sufficient to induce the failure, while increasing it leaves classification intact, suggesting that the adversarial attacks indeed exploit this canonical, well-studied motion statistic.
blocks.zh: 我们假设两种扰动 都以同样的二等运动统计法进行: Hassenstein – Reichardt相亲者读出 [53] 相邻输入之间延迟的关联性,T4/T5方向选择性敏感 [34],而反向-phi已知倒转 [33]. 为了测试这一点,在反事实恢复的每一步中,我们计算了人力资源关联器(Eq. 4)。 我们发现它密切跟踪了运动解码错误(图3c;Supp.图17a)。 支持我们的假设,当网络被最大程度地愚弄时,HR的数值接近于逆phi的数值(图3c,Supp. 图16b)。 为了测试中断这个统计是否足以导致失败,我们单独最小化并最大化了 g (\\\\\\\=8帧=80ms) g (\tau=8\,\mathrm{frames\\\\\\80\,\mathrm{ms} (Eq. 4)),没有访问网络. 在最小化p QQ (命中) p(\text{ hit}) 下降至 0.3\sim 0.3,而在最大化下保持在0.8以上(图3 d; Supp. 图17 b, 13 )。 因此,仅仅操纵这一统计数据就足以导致失败,同时增加其分类不变,这表明对抗性攻击确实利用了这一经充分研究的空洞运动统计数据。

blocks.en: Adversarial failures in FlyNet are therefore not explained by unfamiliar texture statistics. Adversarial textures and reverse-phi invert the same second-order correlation and shift T4/T5 population activity in the same direction, attributing both perturbations to a common vulnerability in the motion representations of FlyNet.
blocks.zh: 因此,不熟悉的纹理统计不能解释FlyNet的负面故障。 反相纹理和反相反相颠倒了相同的二相相关系,并将T4/T5人口活动向同一方向转移,使FlyNet运动表达中的共同脆弱性归咎于两者.

blocks.en: 4.2 Robustness profiles are shaped by structural characteristics
blocks.zh: 4.2 强度剖面由结构特征所决定

blocks.en:
FlyNet’s architecture is predominantly local and feedforward, reflecting the columnar organization of the fly optic lobe [ 56 ] .
This is at odds with what has been typically used in ANNs to provide robustness: recurrence and global integration [ 12 , 13 , 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] .
We asked whether these ingredients are required for robustness in general, and which best account for FlyNet’s robustness profile.
blocks.zh:
FlyNet的架构以本地为主并有源可支,反映了苍蝇光圈的柱形组织[56].
这与ANNs通常用来提供稳健性的情况不符:重复和全球一体化[12、13、15、16、17、18]。
我们问这些成分是否对总体稳健性有要求,

blocks.en: We compared two feedforward CNN baselines that differ only in global pooling: a vanilla CNN (vCNN) with purely local receptive fields, and a variant with an additional channel-wise global pooling pathway that injects a spatially averaged scene representation into the network (gCNN; Supp. Fig. 3 ). gCNN’s pooled global signal helps when it carries perturbation-relevant information that local features lack – additive noise on frames, flicker and high-photon shot noise are all spatially distributed and gCNN beats vCNN under each (Fig. 4 a; Supp. Fig. 23 ). It hurts when the global signal carries little perturbation-relevant information but dominates a weakened local signal – fog, low-photon shot noise, and adversarial textures all reduce local contrast against a still-present scene background, and gCNN underperforms vCNN under each (Fig. 4 a; Supp. Fig. 18 , 19 ; Supp. Fig. 23 ). Global pooling therefore buys robustness conditionally: it does not provide unconditional robustness, and it introduces specific failure modes where the pooled scene average can overwhelm weak local signals.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了两个仅在全球集合中有所不同的有线电视新闻网基线:一个是纯本地接收域的有线电视新闻网(vCNN),另一个是额外的频道全球集合路径,向网络注入空间平均场景(gCNN;Supp.Fig. 3)。 gCNN的集合全球信号在携带当地特征缺乏的扰动相关信息时有所帮助 — — 帧上添加出噪音,闪光器和高发光镜头的噪音都分布在空间上,gCNN在每一个空间下会击败vCNN(图4 a;Supp. 图23)。 当全球信号携带的与扰动相关的信息很少,但却支配着一个被削弱的局部信号 — — 雾、低光发噪声和敌对纹理 — — 都会降低局部与仍然存在的场景背景的对比,而GCNN在每一个场景下都表现不佳(图4a;图18、图19;图23 ) 。 因此,全球集合可以有条件地购买强健性:它不会提供无条件的强健性,它引入了特定的失败模式,而集合场景平均能压倒薄弱的局部信号。

blocks.en: The RAFT model [ 50 ] allows applying an arbitrary number of recurrent refinement iterations. Increasing recurrence depth (1, 6, and 12) in RAFT improved robustness in white-box attack conditions: CW attack success decreased monotonically, and accuracy under PGD increased substantially from RAFT-6 to RAFT-12, with RAFT-1 and RAFT-6 similar. RAFT-12 was also the most robust under additive noise on frames, shot noise, and flicker (Fig. 4 b; Supp. Fig. 18 , 21 , 23 ; Table 2 ). Robustness was unchanged under the black-box NES and transfer attacks and under noise on texture, and decreased under motion jitter and fog, where RAFT-12 was the most vulnerable of the family (Supp. Fig. 19 , 20 , 23 ; Table 2 ). In hexRAFT, recurrence had little or inconsistent effect. Recurrent refinement is therefore a candidate for robustness to white-box attacks in artificial networks. FlyNet is also recurrent, but it updates its state once per frame rather than refining its state over repeated iterations on the same input, so the RAFT result cannot directly carry over to FlyNet.
blocks.zh: RAFT模型[50]允许任意使用次数的反复的精细迭代. RAFT中增加的重现深度(1、6和12)在白箱攻击条件下提高了强度: CW攻击成功率单调下降,PGD下的精确度从RAFT-6大幅提升到RAFT-12,RAFT-1和RAFT-6类似. RAFT-12也是在帧上添加出噪音、打出噪音和闪烁器下最强的(图4b;图18、21、23;表2)。 在黑匣子NES和转移攻击以及纹理受噪声影响的情况下,强势没有改变,在运动快感和雾中减弱,RAFT-12是家庭中最脆弱的群体(附录19、20、23;表2)。 在HexRAFT中,再生效果很少或不一致. 因此,不断改进是人造网络中白盒攻击的优点。 FlyNet也经常出现,但是它每帧更新一次,而不是在相同的输入上对重复的迭代进行提炼,因此RAFT结果不能直接结转到FlyNet.

FlyNet, CTRNN, and sCTRNN integrate their input through continuous-time dynamics (Eq. 1 ), which low-pass filter perturbations that change from frame to frame and provide more temporal context than the two-frame input of CNN and RAFT baselines.
All three continuous-time models are highly robust to motion jitter, flicker and additive noise on frames, above most baselines (Fig. 4 c; Supp. Fig. 23 ; Table 2 ), consistent with this low-pass filtering.
To manipulate temporal context directly in a network without continuous-time dynamics, we retrained vCNN with 5 and 10 input frames instead of 2. Robustness was higher with 5 or 10 frames than with 2 under most perturbation types, and under all common video corruptions (Fig. 4 a; Supp. Fig. 23 ; Table 2 ), showing that temporal context improves robustness to common video corruptions in a feedforward network.

FlyNet,CTRNN,和SCTRNN通过连续时动态(Eq. 1)集成其输入,低通滤波扰动从帧向帧变化,提供的时间背景比CNN和RAFT基线的双帧输入要多.
所有三种连续时间模型都非常坚固,在框架上能运动出快活、闪光和添加噪音,高于大多数基线(图4c;图23;表2),与这种低通滤波一致。
为了在没有连续时间动态的网络中直接操纵时间上下文,我们用5和10个输入帧而不是2来再训练vCNN. 5或10个帧比大多数扰动类型下的2个帧强,在所有常见的视频腐败(图4a;图23;表2)下,显示时间背景改善了向导网络中常见视频腐败的强度。

blocks.en:
The three continuous-time models share dynamics and input but differ in connectivity.
FlyNet’s connectome-derived structure is the most local: The influence-weighted mean distance between perturbed input columns and responding neurons (the projective counterpart [ 57 ] of the effective receptive field [ 58 ] ; see App. A.3 ) is d ¯ ≈ 1.5 \bar{d}\approx 1.5 hexagonal columns, compared to 2.2 2.2 for sCTRNN and 2.8 2.8 for CTRNN ( 2.7 2.7 for vCNN and 4.3 4.3 for gCNN).
CTRNN, with ∼ 5 × {\sim}5\times more edges, is more robust than FlyNet under most perturbations tested, although the gap is small on common video corruptions (Fig. 4 c; Supp. Fig. 18 , 19 , 20 , 21 , 23 ; Table 2 ).
Pruning CTRNN to FlyNet’s edge count and fine-tuning it (sCTRNN) increased robustness under PGD L 2 L_{2} and fog beyond both CTRNN and FlyNet, and matched CTRNN under PGD L ∞ L_{\infty} (Fig. 4 c), but reduced it below CTRNN under L ∞ L_{\infty} transfer attacks, and below both CTRNN and FlyNet under flicker (Supp. Fig. 19 , 20 , 23 ; Table 2 ). The ordering therefore depends on the perturbation, and neither the number of free parameters (Table 1 ), edge count nor locality explain it consistently across these conditions. Under every adversarial attack, FlyNet, the most local model with the fewest free parameters, is the least robust of the three.

blocks.en: Together, these results show that robustness to common video corruptions is consistent with temporal integration and increases when temporal context is added to vCNN, whereas no single tested connectivity property explains the differences among the continuous-time models.

Architectures span five orders of magnitude in compute cost:
FlyNet runs at 0.186 0{.}186 GFLOPs per inference, RAFT-12 at 27,402 27{,}402 GFLOPs, with CNN baselines and CTRNN in between (Fig. 5 a; Table 2 ). Compute does not buy proportional robustness. Within the RAFT family, robustness rises with cost under white-box attacks; but vCNN and gCNN sit at comparable FLOPs and differ substantially in robustness, and on common video corruptions the fly-inspired models achieve high robustness at a fraction of the cost of any other architecture tested. How much robustness does each architecture buy per unit of compute?
blocks.zh:

FlyNet运行于0.186 0{.} 186 GFLOPs按推论计算,RAFT-12运行于27,402 27{,}402 GFLOPs,CNN基线和CTRNN在两者之间(图5a;表2.). 计算不购买比例稳健性。 在RAFT家族内部,在白盒式攻击下,稳健性随成本而上升;但vCNN和gCNN坐落在相仿的FLOP上,强健性差异很大;在常见的视频腐败中,被蝇子启发的模型以测试的任何其他建筑成本的一小部分来达到高稳健性. 每个建筑每个计算单位购买多少坚固度?.

blocks.en: We measure the robustness-efficiency trade-off as LERS = ℛ log 10 ⁡ ℰ , \text{LERS}=\frac{\mathcal{R}}{\log_{10}\mathcal{E}}, (5) where ℰ \mathcal{E} is FLOPs per inference. The logarithmic normalization reflects diminishing returns in robustness from added compute [ 59 ] , and is conservative – it penalizes compute less than linear normalizations would, so any trade-off advantage observed for low-compute architectures would only grow under stricter normalization. LERS represents robustness per order of magnitude of compute (Fig. 5 b, Table 2 ).
blocks.zh: 我们以LERS = R log 10 = E、\text{ LERS = frac = mathcal{ R}}{\log = 10}\ mathcal{E}}]来衡量稳健效率的取舍, (5) E \ mathcal{E} 为 FLOPs / 推论。 对数正常化反映了从附加计算[59]中产生的稳健回报不断减少,并且是保守的 — — 它惩罚计算少于线性正常化,因此低计算结构所观察到的任何取舍优势只有在更严格的正常化下才会增加。 LERS代表每个计算量级的稳健性(图5b,表2)。

blocks.en:
We computed LERS for each model and perturbation type (Fig. 5 b, Table 2 ). Within the CNN and RAFT families, compute differs by less than 4% in log 10 ⁡ ℰ \log_{10}\mathcal{E} , so LERS follows the robustness rankings reported above. Across families, compute spans five orders of magnitude, and on all six common video corruptions the three continuous-time models have the highest LERS of all models.
The one within-group comparison in which LERS departs from robustness is FlyNet versus CTRNN. On common video corruptions, robustness is high for all three continuous-time models ( ℛ ≥ 0.87 \mathcal{R}\geq 0.87 ), and CTRNN’s ∼ 4 × {\sim}4\times higher compute raises its log 10 ⁡ ℰ \log_{10}\mathcal{E} by ∼ 7.5 % {\sim}7.5\% , more than its robustness lead over FlyNet; FlyNet therefore has higher LERS than CTRNN on common corruptions, although CTRNN is more robust. FlyNet and sCTRNN, with nearly identical compute, are ordered by ℛ \mathcal{R} alone and reach comparable LERS. Under PGD L 2 L_{2} and NES, CTRNN’s robustness lead exceeds the compute difference, and both CTRNNs rank above FlyNet. sCTRNN is more robust than FlyNet at slightly lower compute and has the highest LERS of all models under PGD and transfer attacks.
Together, these results show that FlyNet’s low edge count, and hence low compute, gives it higher LERS than CTRNN and all baselines other than sCTRNN on common video corruptions, despite CTRNN’s higher raw robustness. sCTRNN, matched to FlyNet’s edge count, reaches comparable LERS without FlyNet’s synapse-level wiring.

blocks.en: 5 Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: Robust and efficient sensory processing is a hallmark of biological neural circuits, yet the architectural principles that support this combination remain poorly understood. Here, we asked whether synaptic wiring derived from the connectome contributes to either property beyond what standard artificial architectures and task training achieve. To answer this, we built a differentiable 3D rendering pipeline for looming-based collision detection and benchmarked a connectome-constrained, task-optimized model of the fly visual system (FlyNet) against unconstrained CNN, globally pooled CNN, CTRNN, and RAFT-based baselines under adversarial attacks and common video perturbations. Recurrence (in RAFT), global context, and temporal context each support robustness under different perturbation regimes. FlyNet’s connectome constraint, however, does not seem to contribute to robustness — CTRNN and sCTRNN, which lack detailed connectome constraints, are more robust than FlyNet under almost every perturbation tested. What the connectome seems to contribute is efficiency through sparsity: FlyNet matches CTRNN closely on common video corruptions while using a fraction of the synapses and compute, yielding higher LERS than any architecture other than sCTRNN. Our comparison to sCTRNN suggests that this efficiency advantage is not unique to the connectome’s specific wiring. While FlyNet is robust to the tested common video corruptions it remains sensitive to optimized adversarial attacks (gradient-based PGD, gradient-free NES) indicating that biological structure alone does not imply general adversarial robustness. The fly itself is susceptible to a structured stimulus: Reverse-phi inverts the contrast of moving patterns and produces illusory motion in real flies — a perceptual error that reflects a specific computational vulnerability of the T4/T5 motion-detection circuit. FlyNet inherits this vulnerability, and our analysis shows that adversarial optimization discovers stimuli that exploit the same failure mode: Both invert the Hassenstein–Reichardt correlation between neighboring inputs, and manipulating that second-order correlation statistic alone suffices to induce the failure.
blocks.zh: 强而高效的感官处理是生物神经回路的标志,然而支持这种组合的建筑原理仍然不甚了解. 在这里,我们询问,从连接体中衍生出来的突触线是否有助于超出标准人工建筑和任务培训所达到的特性。 为了应对这种情况,我们建造了一个不同的3D渲染管道,用于基于迫近的碰撞探测,并以对抗性攻击和常见视频扰动为基准,将飞行视觉系统(FlyNet)的连接式、任务优化模型与不受约束的CNN、全球集合的CNN、CTRNN和基于RAFT的基线进行对比。 重复(在RAFT中)、全球背景和时间背景都支持不同扰动制度下的稳健性。 然而,FlyNet的连通性制约似乎并没有促进稳健性——CTRNN和SCTRNN缺乏详细的连通性制约,在几乎每一次扰动测试下都比FlyNet更强健. 连接体似乎有助于通过痉挛来提高效率: FlyNet在常见视频腐败上与CTRNN紧密相匹配,同时使用突触和计算中的一小部分,产生比SCTRNN以外的任何架构更高的LERS. 我们和SCTRNN的比较表明,这种效率优势并非是连接体特定的接线所特有的. FlyNet虽然对经过测试的常见视频腐败很强,但对优化对抗性攻击(基于梯度的PGD,无梯度的NES)仍然很敏感,这表明仅生物结构并不意味着一般对抗性强. 苍蝇本身容易受到结构性刺激: 反向反向反向反向反向移动模式的对比,在真蝇中产生虚幻运动——一种能反映T4/T5运动-探测回路的特定计算脆弱性的感知错误. FlyNet继承了这种脆弱性,我们的分析显示,对抗优化发现了利用同一种失败模式的刺激: 两者都颠倒了相邻输入之间的哈森施泰因-雷查德关联,而操纵二等关联统计本身就足以诱发失败。

blocks.en:
In the fly, downstream looming-selective neurons, such as LPLC2 and LC4, project to escape pathways [ 24 , 25 ] that are not present in FlyNet. Beyond connectivity, biological circuits compute under additional constraints such as neuromodulation, synaptic plasticity, synaptic stochasticity [ 14 ] , and spiking — none of which FlyNet models. Some asymmetries complicate cross-architecture comparison.
First, decoder input dimensionality differs across architectures, which could confound cross-architecture robustness comparisons: a higher-dimensional readout may itself contribute to measured robustness rather than the backbone alone, leaving this as an axis for future work.
Second, sCTRNN and FlyNet share edge count and compute but beyond wiring differ by more than three orders of magnitude in trainable parameters (1,513,361 vs 734; Table 1 ; Supp. Fig. 2 ), as well as in training pipeline (sCTRNN is fine-tuned), so differences between them cannot be attributed to synapse-level connectome constraints alone.
Third, our robustness and efficiency results hold for the binary looming task, while generalization to other visual tasks, such as object tracking or navigation, and under more naturalistic scenes, remains untested and left as future work.
Fourth, each architecture is represented by a single trained instance, so error bars reflect stimulus and attack variability, not variability across trained networks.
Finally, our compute estimate uses FLOPs, which enables consistent cross-architecture comparison but does not measure the metabolic cost of biological computation [ 3 , 2 , 60 , 61 ] .

blocks.en:
In general, adversarial vulnerability appears to be a consequence of specialized computational strategies:
Networks become robust to the perturbations they were trained on and vulnerable to perturbations designed against their architecture. Adversarial training is the field’s canonical answer, raising the question whether the connectome’s wiring already sits closer to an adversarially trained solution than an artificial neural network trained from scratch.
Differentiable connectome-constrained models also turn adversarial attacks into a tool that can interface with experiments in biology. Future connectome-constrained models that incorporate downstream circuits and greater biological realism will generate more faithful predictions of adversarial stimuli for experimental tests.
Because the correlation-based motion motif is shared with mammalian motion vision [ 62 , 23 ] , the approach could extend to larger connectome models as a route to candidate illusions for mammalian circuits.
Our work suggests adversarial analysis as a tool for probing the limits of biological computation, while also informing the design of specialized neural networks that achieve favorable robustness–efficiency trade-offs. Immediate future work will focus on isolating the role of the connectome in robustness and address the generalization of these findings across more tasks.
blocks.zh:
一般来说,对抗性的脆弱性似乎是专门计算战略的结果:
网络变得强大起来,能够应付他们所训练的干扰,容易受到针对其建筑设计的干扰。 反常的训练是野外的空洞答案, 提出了连接体的接线是否已经比训练出来的人工神经网络更接近对抗性训练的解决方案的问题。
可分化的连接自控自控模型也会将对抗性攻击变成一种能够与生物学实验相接的工具. 未来连接体受约束的模型,包括下游回路和更大的生物现实主义,将产生对实验试验的对抗刺激的更忠实的预测.
由于基于相关性的运动摩蒂夫被和哺乳动物运动视觉共享[62,23],这种方法可以被扩展至更大的连接体模型,作为哺乳动物回路候选错觉的通路.
我们的工作建议进行对抗性分析,作为探究生物计算极限的工具,同时也为设计专门神经网络提供参考,以实现有利的强性-效率取舍。 近期的工作将侧重于将连接体的作用从强性中分离出来,并处理在更多任务中概括这些结论的问题。

blocks.en: FlyNet [ 10 ] is a differentiable neural network whose architecture is derived from a synapse-level connectome reconstruction of the Drosophila optic lobe, covering 65 cell types. The network topology, which neurons are connected and with what anatomical synapse counts, is fixed by connectomic measurements and not modified during training. What is learned are the unknown biophysical parameters: the single-neuron time constants τ i \tau_{i} , resting potentials h i r ​ e ​ s ​ t h_{i}^{rest} , and synaptic strength parameters that scale the fixed anatomical weights, yielding only 734 free parameters in total. These parameters are optimized using standard deep learning techniques to minimize an optical flow prediction loss on the Sintel dataset [ 11 ] . Crucially, no electrophysiological data are used during training: the model recovers single-neuron response properties consistent with three decades of experimental measurements as an emergent consequence of fitting the motion task under the connectome constraint. FlyNet has 45,669 neurons and 1.51M synaptic connections, and is governed by the continuous-time dynamics in Eq. 1 , where f f is a ReLU nonlinearity applied to pre-synaptic voltages, and l i l_{i} represents the luminance input to photoreceptors (for all other cell types, l i = 0 l_{i}=0 ).

FlyNet有45,669个神经元和1.51M突触连接,受Eq. 1的连续时动态所支配,ff是用于突触前电压的ReLU非线性,而l i l_{i}代表了光受体的发光输入(对于所有其他细胞类型,l i = 0 l_{i}=0).

blocks.en: We specifically decode T4 and T5 motion pathways (Supp. Fig. 1 ). The original work reports neural tuning averaged over clusters of 50 equivalently configured and stochastically trained model instances, and individual instances can deviate from known tuning properties. However, no single pretrained model exhibits correct direction selectivity for all T4 and T5 subtypes simultaneously. In the model with the best Sintel validation loss, T4d prefers OFF instead of ON contrast and is only weakly direction selective, whereas all other T4 and T5 subtypes have the expected contrast preference and preferred direction. We therefore constructed a hybrid model: starting from the best-loss model, we replaced the resting potential and time constant of T4d, and the synaptic strengths of all ten connection types onto T4d, with those of the second-best model, whose T4d prefers ON contrast. After this substitution, all T4 and T5 subtypes have the expected contrast preference and preferred direction, and T4d becomes strongly direction selective (Supp. Fig. 1 b,c).

blocks.en: CTRNN follows the same continuous-time dynamics as FlyNet (Eq. 1 ), receives the same hexagonal input, but its weights w i ​ j w_{ij} are not constrained by the connectome. CTRNN learns weights of free signs for all connected cell-type pairs over a support of a 19-column hexagonal neighborhood (five columns across), increasing edge count from 1.51M to 7.51M and increasing the number of free parameters from 734 734 to 11,593 11{,}593 . CTRNN thus serves as an ablation of the synapse-level connectome prior while holding the dynamical framework constant. CTRNN is the best-Sintel-validation network from Extended Data Fig. 2, DMN[11,593] in [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: CTRNN遵循与FlyNet(Eq. 1)相同的连续时动态,得到相同的六边形输入,但其权重w i j w_{ij}不受连接体的限制. CTRNN在19个柱形六边形街区(横跨5个柱)的支撑下,学习所有相通的细胞型对子的自由标志的权重,将边数从1.51M增加到7.51M,并将自由参数从734 734增加到11 593 11{,}593. 因此,CTRNN在保持动态框架常数的同时,充当了突触级连接器的前发音. CTRNN是来自扩展数据图2,DMN[11,593]在[10]中的最佳-辛特尔验证网络.

blocks.zh: A.1.3 sCTRNN (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en: sCTRNN is obtained from the trained CTRNN by untying the shared filter weights and pruning per edge by the mean absolute injected current, down to FlyNet’s 1.51M connections, followed by fine-tuning on Sintel. sCTRNN matches FlyNet’s edge count of 1,513,231.
blocks.zh: sCTRNN从训练有素的CTRNN中取出,将共享的滤波器权重解绑定,并用平均绝对注入电流逐一推开,下至FlyNet的1.51M接通,再于Sintel上进行微调. SCTRNN与FlyNet的边数1,513,231相匹配.

blocks.en: A.1.4 CNNs
blocks.zh: A.1.4 有线电视新闻网

blocks.en: We considered unconstrained CNN baselines trained on Sintel. The vanilla CNN consists of five layers with 32, 92, 136, 8, and 2 channels, respectively. All layers use a kernel size of 5, except for the last layer, which uses a kernel size of 1. Each layer consists of a convolution, batch normalization, and an exponential linear unit activation, except for the final layer, which applies only a convolution. The global pooling network uses the same architecture, but includes a global average pooling operation between the second and third layers, providing the network with access to global spatial context (Supp. Fig. 3 ). Among our CNNs, only vCNN(2f) is one of five networks from Extended Data Fig. 2, vanilla CNN in [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 我们认为有线电视新闻网的基线不受限制, 香草CNN由五层组成,分别有32个,92个,136个,8个和2个频道. 所有地层都使用内核大小为5,但上层除外,上层使用内核大小为1. 每个地层由一个回旋,批量正常化,和一个指数线性单位活化组成,除了最后地层,它只应用了回旋. 全球集合网络使用相同的架构,但包括了第二层和第三层之间的全球平均集合操作,为网络提供了全球空间背景(Supp. fig. 3 ) 。 在我们的有线电视新闻网中,只有vCNN(2f)是来自扩展数据图2的五个网络之一,梵地拉有线电视新闻网在[10]中.

blocks.en: A.1.5 RAFT
blocks.zh: A.1.5 拉法特

blocks.en: We use RAFT as a high-performance optical flow baseline, pretrained on standard benchmarks, and fine-tuned on Sintel. We extract feature maps from the final hidden representation prior to flow output. Given its size 128 × H / 8 × W / 8 128\times H/8\times W/8 (we use H = W = 416 H=W=416 ), we apply 2D average pooling (kernel size 7, stride 7), resulting in 6,802 6,802 features for decoding.
blocks.zh: 我们使用RAFT作为高性能光学流线基线,在标准基准上预先训练,在辛特尔上进行微调. 我们在流出输出前从最终隐藏的表示中提取特征图. 由于其尺寸为128×H / 8×W / 8 128\times H/8\times W (我们使用 H = W = 416 H = W = 416),我们应用了 2D 平均集合(内核尺寸为 7, stride 7),从而产生了 6,802 6,802 个解码功能.

blocks.en: To control for differences in visual sampling, we additionally trained a FlyNet-matched RAFT model (hexRAFT) using the same hexagonal sampling geometry as FlyNet (Supp. Fig. 4 ). Sintel frames were converted to luminance and sampled through an array of 721 hexagonally arranged photoreceptors, each performing spatial averaging over a 13 × 13 13\times 13 pixel receptive field. The resulting samples were mapped onto a 31 × 31 31\times 31 Cartesian grid, zero-padded to 32 × 32 32\times 32 , and bilinearly upsampled to 256 × 256 256\times 256 to produce RAFT-compatible inputs. The same sampling procedure was applied to the ground-truth optical flow, without rescaling flow magnitudes, and a validity mask excluded unsampled grid locations from the training loss. We trained the model on the Clean and Final passes of Sintel using the same scene-disjoint training split, for 50,000 50,000 iterations with a batch size of 8, using AdamW ( lr = 10 − 4 \mathrm{lr}=10^{-4} , weight decay = 10 − 5 =10^{-5} ) and 12 12 recurrent update iterations.
blocks.zh: 为了控制视觉取样方面的差异,我们还培训了一个与FlyNet相匹配的RAFT模型(hexRAFT),采用了与FlyNet相同的六边形取样几何学(Supp.Fig. 4)。 辛特尔帧被转换为发光,并通过由721个六边形排列的受光器组成的阵列进行采样,每个受光器在13×13相13相13相13相13相13相13相13相接受的场上进行空间平均. 生成的样品被映射到31×31相31相31相31笛卡尔网格上,零加成32×32相32相32相32相32相32相,并双线地被取样到256×256相256相256相256相256相相相兼容的输入. 地面-真实光学流动也采用了同样的取样程序,但没有调整流量规模,而且一个有效性罩将未取样的网格位置排除在培训损失之外。 我们使用相同的场景-分相训练分出法,对辛特尔的"清洁和最终通道"模型进行了训练,使用 AdamW (lr = 10 – 4\ mathrm{lr}=10^{4}),重量衰减 = 10− 5 = 10^{5} 和 12 个经常性更新重排.

blocks.en: B.6.1 Adversarial attacks

blocks.en: We perform untargeted adversarial attacks over the object texture by optimizing a free logit variable, ensuring valid pixel intensities through a sigmoid transformation. All adversarial evaluations are performed on 100 time-steps hit trajectories with Black initial texture where baseline accuracy exceeds 90%, ensuring that failures arise from perturbations rather than pre-existing model errors. For PGD [ 8 ] , we iteratively update the texture to maximize misclassification under L ∞ L_{\infty} and L 2 L_{2} constraints via projection, using 100 steps with step size α = ε / 10 \alpha=\varepsilon/10 . During optimization, we employ an adaptive step-size scheme inspired by [ 54 ] : at fixed checkpoints of 20 steps, if the loss fails to improve, the step size is halved and the iterate is reset to the best solution found so far; otherwise, optimization proceeds with the current step size. We sweep over ε L ∞ = [ 1 , 6 , 8 , 10 , 15 ] \varepsilon_{L_{\infty}}=[1,6,8,10,15] and ε L 2 = [ 100,250,500 , 1000 , 2000 ] \varepsilon_{L_{2}}=[100,250,500,1000,2000] . Recall we optimize the texture in logit space. Each attack uses 2 random restarts from noise within the constraint set, and we run 15 independent attacks per condition. We report the highest label-flip rate across restarts. We then use the resulting PGD adversarial textures to assess transfer by applying them directly to the other models. For CW attacks [ 37 ] , we optimize the same variable using Adam to minimize a distance term plus a misclassification objective, performing a grid search over c = [ 1 , 10 , 10 2 , 10 3 , 10 4 , 10 5 ] c=[1,10,10^{2},10^{3},10^{4},10^{5}] with 150 steps and lr = 10 − 1 \text{lr}=10^{-1} , evaluating both L ∞ L_{\infty} and L 2 L_{2} distances. Finally, for the gradient-free NES method [ 38 ] , we estimate the update direction using symmetric Gaussian perturbations, sweeping over σ = [ 1 , 3 , 6 , 9 , 12 ] \sigma=[1,3,6,9,12] , using 100 optimization steps with 15 gradient-estimation samples per step and a normalized update, and running 15 attacks per condition.
